checks.name: having threshold
checks.sql: SELECT d.name, SUM(w.hours) AS total_hours FROM departments d INNER JOIN worklog w ON d.id = w.dept_id GROUP BY d.name HAVING SUM(w.hours) >= 5 ORDER BY total_hours DESC, d.name;

checks.name: group order expression
checks.sql: SELECT d.name, SUM(w.hours) AS total_hours, COUNT(*) AS entry_count FROM departments d INNER JOIN worklog w ON d.id = w.dept_id GROUP BY d.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY total_hours - entry_count DESC, d.name;
